notes: This dataset contains the data and the parameter files used for producing the figures in the article named "Simulating interactions between cytoskeletal filaments" by Pajanonot et al. The contents of this folder are folders containing the data and parameter files used for each of the figures and subfigures of the article. These data have been produced by Sophia Hampe and Kristian Pajanonot. A customised currently unpublished version of cytosim have been used to produce these data. If you have any questions about the data please contact Stefan Klumpp stefam.klumpp@phys.uni-goettingen.de.
